analogy.rationale: AR antagonists act on the androgen receptor, which is expressed at low levels in most of these cell lines (notably absent in A375, A549, HA1E, HCC515, HEPG2, HT29, MCF7), so transcriptional responses should be weak; the closest analogs are other nuclear-receptor ligands, especially androgen receptor modulators, with weaker similarity to other steroid receptor ligands.
